issues.where: the upper globe, the bats
issues.what: four big flat blue-grey bat cutouts, doubled and stacked like stickers, hang near the top of the glass; in -a the bats are two or three small crisp black silhouettes flying among the branches
issues.fix: replace them with two or three small solid black bat silhouettes at -a's scale, set among the tree's upper branches and lit only by edge glow

issues.where: the tree
issues.what: the tree is brown and squat, and its crown is a dense cloud of glowing points that reads as autumn foliage; in -a it is a bare black, gnarled tree with twisting limbs reaching to the top of the globe and a few small lights on its branches
issues.fix: rebuild the tree as -a's bare black silhouette: taller and twisted, open branches spreading up and right, a sparse scatter of small lights along the limbs, and no glowing mass in the crown

issues.where: the ground inside the globe in front of the cottage
issues.what: the pond, the stone steps and the curving stone path are missing; there is a flat orange-leaf lawn with a small reflection blob and a mottled teal band beneath it; -a has a dark reflective pond in the foreground, a flagstone path and steps from the door, and grassy banks
issues.fix: restore the pond in the lower right foreground with its reflections, the flagstone path and steps from the door, and the grassy rocky banks; thin the leaf cover on the ground to -a's scattered leaves

issues.where: the green glow in the lower globe
issues.what: -a's luminous green mist, which rises from the collar, lights the scene from below and haloes the cottage and tree, has become a dull flat mottled teal band, so the interior looks murky and the glass loses its glow
issues.fix: bring back a bright, soft, volumetric green mist along the bottom of the sphere, glowing strongest at the collar and fading upward behind the cottage and the tree trunk

issues.where: the particles in the liquid across the whole globe
issues.what: -a fills the whole sphere evenly with crisp, distinct falling leaves and warm embers at many depths, plus large soft bokeh discs; -b bunches the specks around the tree like noise and leaves the upper left and top mostly empty, with few readable leaf shapes
issues.fix: spread crisp leaves and warm ember points evenly through the whole volume, up to the top of the glass, with a few large defocused orange discs near the glass

issues.where: the cottage, door and fence
issues.what: the cottage sits smaller and further back, the arched door with its lit stone surround is hidden behind leaves, the chimney is taller with a knob on top, ivy has been added on the left wall, and the picket fence has become a low dark rail; in -a the arched door, the picket fence running down to the left and the pumpkin at the door are all clear
issues.fix: match -a's cottage scale and placement, show the arched wooden door and stone arch, use the short square chimney, remove the ivy, and restore the tall wooden picket fence running down to the front left

issues.where: the lamp post
issues.what: the lamp is small and dim; in -a its lantern glows warm and bright and lights the area around it
issues.fix: enlarge the lantern to -a's size and give it a bright warm glow with a small halo

issues.where: the top of the glass
issues.what: a hard, saucer-shaped dished highlight sits on the crown of the sphere; -a has no such cap, only soft broad highlights on the upper right
issues.fix: remove the disc at the crown and keep the soft curved highlight on the upper right

issues.where: the glass rim and its reflections
issues.what: the rim is a thin cool blue outline; -a has a warm orange rim light along the left edge, light streaks on the right, and a warm-lit web of fine cracks; -b's cracks are long, sparse, white dotted lines
issues.fix: warm the left rim with orange light, add the soft vertical streaks on the right, and make the cracks finer and branching, lit warm like -a's web

issues.where: the wax on the collar and the base
issues.what: the wax is matte tan, like clay or rope, with short stubby drips; in -a it is glossy pale cream with long shiny runs down the thorns; cream bone-like pegs stand upright on the surface at the foot, where -a has wax pooling
issues.fix: make the wax glossy cream with specular highlights and longer irregular drips, and replace the upright pegs at the foot with low pooled wax puddles

issues.where: the thorn wreath of the base
issues.what: the thorns are uniform glossy tubes woven in a regular braid around oval eye-holes; -a's are irregular gnarled branches with long sharp spikes, organic and chaotic, with a cobweb on the right where -b has a straw-like tuft
issues.fix: make the branches irregular in thickness and direction with sharper spikes, drop the regular weave, and restore a fine translucent cobweb on the right side

issues.where: the jack-o'-lanterns in the base
issues.what: the pumpkins are dim and sunk in oval holes, with little orange spill on the surrounding thorns; in -a they glow bright orange-yellow and cast warm light on the branches around them
issues.fix: raise their emission to -a's brightness and add orange bounce light on the nearby thorns

issues.where: the surface under the base and its mirror image
issues.what: the glossy black surface with bright orange reflections of the pumpkins under the base is mostly gone; the surface reads as a hazy grey-blue, and the leaves are a dense dark red-brown carpet around the foot instead of sparse golden leaves with glints
issues.fix: make the surface glossy black and wet, with clear warm reflections of the pumpkins and the base below the foot; thin the leaves to -a's sparse, lighter, glinting scatter

issues.where: the background lights and the overall colour
issues.what: the bokeh behind is fewer, dimmer and partly teal, and the whole frame is cooler and lower in contrast, so the warm glowing Halloween mood of -a turns flat and CG
issues.fix: add more large warm orange bokeh discs at -a's positions and brightness, and warm the grade and lift the contrast so the globe glows against a deep dark background

issues.where: the storm in the liquid
issues.what: -a's storm is fine bright motion streaks and light trails swirling with green currents; -b's is a mass of smeared ochre leaf blobs with almost no bright streaks and little sense of swirl
issues.fix: add many thin bright warm streaks along curved swirl paths, with green current ribbons through the volume, and render the leaves as smaller, partly streaked orange and red pieces at -a's density

issues.where: how much of the miniature shows through the storm
issues.what: the storm hides almost all of the miniature: the cottage is lost except its windows, the tree is a faint smudge, and the lamp and the pumpkins barely read; in -a the cottage, door, lamp, tree trunk and pumpkins stay clearly legible through the streaks
issues.fix: thin the storm in front of the miniature so the cottage outline, door, lamp, trunk and glowing pumpkins read clearly, as in -a

issues.where: the lower globe, the green floor
issues.what: the bottom of the sphere is a pale, flat mint band with smeared stripes; -a has a deeper luminous green swirl mixed with leaves and streaks
issues.fix: deepen the bottom green and make it glow, and carry the swirl, the leaves and the streaks down into it

issues.where: the leaf colour in the storm
issues.what: the leaves are one uniform yellow-ochre; -a mixes orange, red, rust and gold with green, so the colour varies
issues.fix: vary the leaf hues from orange and red to rust and gold, and let the green read between them

issues.where: the glass: crown, rim and cracks
issues.what: these have the same faults as in set A: a dished saucer highlight on the crown, a thin cool blue rim with no warm edge light, and sparse white dotted crack lines
issues.fix: remove the crown disc, warm the left rim, and make the cracks fine and branching, as in -a

issues.where: the base, the wax and the pumpkins
issues.what: these have the same faults as in set A: matte tan stubby wax, regular braided glossy thorns, upright cream pegs at the foot, a straw tuft in place of the cobweb, and dim pumpkins with no orange spill
issues.fix: match -a: glossy cream drips, irregular spiky branches, pooled wax at the foot, a fine cobweb, and bright pumpkins lighting the thorns

issues.where: the surface, the mirror image and the background
issues.what: the warm pumpkin reflections under the base are missing, the leaf carpet is dense and dark where -a has sparse glinting leaves, the background bokeh is fewer and cooler, and the overall grade is cooler and flatter
issues.fix: restore the wet black surface with warm reflections, thin the leaves, and bring back the warm bokeh and the higher-contrast warm grade

issues.where: the bats in the storm
issues.what: -a shows two or three small black bats tumbling in the storm; -b shows none
issues.fix: add two or three small black bat silhouettes caught in the swirl, at -a's scale
